about: Mod lists published between HotSwap releases. Same shape as CATALOG/LIVE/ENGINE_CATS in ui/data.js (mods as objects: {type, name, info, spec, min, max, step, def}). Bump version, then sign: cargo tauri signer sign -f <hotswap.key> -p "" catalog/mods.json. Mods that run code (js) are dropped by the app.
